verdict.rationale: Fathom documents official TypeScript and Python SDKs, with install pages (npm install fathom-typescript; Python via uv). The docs describe the SDKs handling authentication, pagination, error handling and automatic Retry-After retries, plus OAuth 2.0 support, a verifyWebhook helper and filtering guides. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the SDKs work as documented.
